- 修复部分 Java 环境下中文文件名、路径及错误详情显示乱码的问题，统一加固、签名与环境探测的 Java 工具输出编码。
- 保留中文证书 Alias 兼容，不修改系统 Java 环境、配置或加固协议；最低仍需完整 JDK 8。
- 已通过 JDK 8/11/17 回归及真实中文名 APK 加固、签名验证；本候选版邀请受影响用户重点验证 Windows 原生场景，尚不宣称其签名识别失败已全部解决。

- Fixed garbled Chinese filenames, paths and error details in some Java environments by unifying Java tool output encoding across hardening, signing and environment detection.
- Retained Chinese certificate alias compatibility without changing system Java settings, configuration or the protection format. A full JDK 8 or newer is still required.
- Tested with JDK 8/11/17 and a real APK using Chinese filenames. This release candidate seeks validation on affected Windows environments; not all reported signature detection failures are confirmed resolved.
